sections.title: Talking about the future: meaning and form
body: Goal: Tell the difference between an arrangement, an intention and a prediction, and make a clear future plan.
Core vocabulary: en plan, nästa vecka, förmodligen. Key phrases: Jag ska träffa läkaren på fredag. · Jag tänker börja cykla till jobbet. · Det kommer att regna i kväll.

Swedish often uses present tense with a future time word. Ska commonly marks a plan or arrangement, tänker marks an intention, and kommer att often marks a prediction. Context matters more than translating one English future form.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.fi: Jag ska träffa läkaren på fredag.
examples.en: I am going to see the doctor on Friday.

examples.fi: Jag tänker börja cykla till jobbet.
examples.en: I intend to start cycling to work.

examples.fi: Det kommer att regna i kväll.
examples.en: It is going to rain this evening.

body: Register model: “Skulle vi kunna flytta tiden?” is a polite service request way to express “Could we move the appointment?”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What does the speaker intend to do after work? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: When does the group meet? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Tell a friend about one fixed arrangement, one personal intention and one prediction for next week. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a weekend plan with times, transport and one alternative if the weather changes. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: Your Saturday train is cancelled; adjust the plan and explain what you will do instead.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
